items.statement: Related party transactions are around 15% of total revenue, mostly with subsidiaries; money flows both ways and is counted twice for ROC disclosure.
items.quote: Sir, it is not 69%, it is 15.1% of the total revenue. Majority is with the subsidiaries. If we count INR15 crores, if the money goes and comes back, then it is treated as twice.

items.statement: Related party transactions expected to remain between 10%-15% of revenue; used for short-term funding in gold loan business at arm's length rates.
items.quote: No, it is between 10%-15%. It is still around 15%. We have to disclose it from the ROC perspective. In ROC, if the money comes and goes, we have to call the total of both.
